protocol.algorithm: One preselected FP32 FEM trajectory in a device-controlled CUDA Graph, followed by conditional-QUBO CPU refinement
protocol.timing: Fresh standalone C++/CUDA executable, parent launch through host-available refined partition. Input/model/cached-mode loading, CUDA initialization, graph preparation/search/readout and CPU refinement included. Prior mode construction and policy calibration, audit and archival excluded.
protocol.cuda_timing: Wall interval for one CUDA Graph submission through completed host readout; excludes input/model/context/graph preparation and CPU refinement; not a complete solver latency.
protocol.statistics: Best cut of three trials; median per-trial full process time and median CUDA interval from those same three runs; not time to best-of-three cut
